reason: I forget my vitamins on the counter half the time, so one sachet with the capsules already counted is something I'd actually take. The lab report on the box and the money-back guarantee make a first box at $24.99 an easy impulse buy.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, 30 foil packets a month is a lot of trash.
would_change_my_mind: If the video showed a creator who had the same forgetting problem and it clearly worked for her, I'd be even surer. If the foil sachets were not recyclable and it bugged me more, I'd skip it.
